visual_review: All8panels inspected: deep rounded eclipses, alternating parity curves offset in time on opposite sides of joint center in all4sectors; depth difference less consistent. Full-orbit panels show no comparably deep additional eclipse away from primary.
limits: Posthoc evidence favors testing doubled-period eclipsing interpretation, but no formal timing fit or unique host/physical classification. Secondary maxima selected and uncalibrated; no exclusion of faint secondary.
